reason: v1 had 97/576 cells with unknown usage (81 transport failures, 16 provider content rejections), so H1 token reduction was not estimable. v2 changes only transport limits and reruns the whole matrix; tasks, arms, model and analysis rules are unchanged.
margin_justification: Unchanged from v1: at most one additional failure per 20 runs in a non-safety-critical transformation workflow; frozen before v2 execution.

transport_policy.stream_cap: The connector aborts and records a transport failure when a provider stream exceeds 1 MiB.
transport_policy.deadline: The connector stops at min(55 s, remaining-5 s); the harness still kills at min(90 s, remaining).
transport_policy.retries: No automatic transport retry. A call that exhausts the cap or deadline makes its run an adapter failure with unknown usage, retained in denominators.
transport_policy.rationale: Retrying after an aborted stream cannot recover the aborted call's token usage, so usage would remain incomplete. v2 fixes the failure mode instead of masking it.

moderation_policy: Unchanged: provider content rejections are terminal, unretried failures with unknown usage, retained in every denominator; sensitivity excludes only provider-rejection runs.
attribution_policy: Unchanged: provider totals only; per-message attribution null; H3 uses total input tokens and returned feedback bytes.

analysis.primary: D versus A: total tokens and success non-inferiority
analysis.rules: Identical to v1. v2 is reported separately and never pooled with v1 or the pilot.

execution: Whole matrix, 576 cells. May be executed as disjoint shards of the frozen plan; no cell may duplicate, and shard membership is not analyzed.
